content: Standard pattern for virtualized/infinite feeds: observe a stable ancestor container (not individual items, which get destroyed/recreated) with MutationObserver({childList:true, subtree:true}), debounce the callback (rAF or ~50-100ms) since virtualized feeds fire many mutations per scroll tick, then re-scan only added nodes. IntersectionObserver complements this by deferring expensive work (image swap, button injection) until a tweet actually enters viewport, and its disconnect/unobserve on node removal doubles as cleanup when React recycles/destroys the node. Always disconnect observers on scroll-container removal to avoid leaks.
